headline: Indonesia Considers First Subsidized Fuel Price Hike Amid High Oil Prices
summary: Indonesia has discussed hiking subsidized fuel prices for the first time since 2022 as a weakening local currency and high oil prices weigh on government subsidy outlays.
why: Indonesia is Southeast Asia's largest economy and the fourth-most populous country globally, making energy subsidy adjustments significant for fiscal outlays.

impacts.name: Indonesia
impacts.why: Potential fuel price hikes impact government expenditures and domestic inflation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
